The formal legal basis for Canadian independence was established in 1931 with the passage of the Statute of Westminster, which granted Canada full legislative equality with other British dominions

Canada's full independence was not complete until 1982, when the Canada Act received royal assent from Queen Elizabeth II, formally ending Canada's legal subjection to British Parliamentary legislation
